Test 2 replaced that registry call by assigning pooch the identical md5 registry entries I fetched and verified against the figshare DOI registry during setup (both files matched provider md5 and byte size), and it passed that point, but then failed at line 55 EXAMPLE_DATA.fetch(filename): the run log shows pooch resolving its cache to /root/.cache/scverse_tutorials, while the recipe stages inputs at /work/cache/scverse_tutorials (XDG_CACHE_HOME is not set in the reference process), so fetch treated the files as absent and attempted a network download. The setup now contains the corrected analysis.py with both necessary offline cache adaptations (pooch path pointing at /work/cache/scverse_tutorials, plus the recorded DOI registry entries) and the recipe and inputs are otherwise validated: dependency installation, input staging with md5/size verification against the provider checksums, and exclusions handling all succeeded in both tests. This preserves pooch's fetch-time md5 verification of the staged files without network access.
